cuts.note: the AI vestibule: two beams hanging from 1.6 m with nothing below; replaced by our door, piers and slat soffit
the AI garden gate: its leaf and the beam over the opening (it hung at 1.6 m, right through the camera path); our gate replaces it
the front of the west planter mass, its gate pier and the niche (melted, smeared); court.ts rebuilds them, its coping laps the torn edge of the mass's top
baked bush blobs at the foot of the west wall; court.ts plants the bed there
the black shards across the gate opening: the foot of the AI gate leaf under the gate-leaf cut; court.ts lays a stone sill
the east garden wall, the intercom blob and the planter recess, and the corner of the east wing's front; court.ts rebuilds the wall, its piers and the beds
the facade fin behind the east gate pier up to the porch canopy: a 16 cm sliver with torn edges after the portal cut; court.ts rebuilds it whole
the golden bush blob round the foot of the column on the west planter mass (seen past the west porch pier all the way in); court.ts sets a planter and a real shrub there

the AI shell's torn stub between the living room's front wall (gf-interior ends at z -1.6), the wing (gf-wing) and the portal cut: a jagged zig-zag slab 0.2-0.5 m outside the living room's front window (seen through it from the curtain and speaker stops); from the street interior.ts's porch wall (z -0.36…-0.14) hides the space
what the portal cut left under 0.3 m east of the steps: the AI porch's raised slab, a dark wedge and a post stub, standing through interior.ts's porch paving (y 0.012)
